title: 特朗普威胁要轰炸传统盟友阿曼
summary: 美国总统威胁称，如果阿曼妨碍华盛顿方面与伊朗达成重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的协议，美国将轰炸这个海湾国家。

title: 美国人对特朗普治下的经济日益悲观
summary: 在美伊战争加剧生活负担危机、迫使美国人缩减支出的背景下，8月消费者信心指数大幅下降，高油价沉重打击老年和低收入人群。

title: US condemns 'unnecessary escalation' after Israeli airstrikes on Syrian airbase
summary: Damascus called the attacks "an unjustified act of aggression" that imperilled regional security.

title: Eleven killed in Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon, authorities say
summary: Israel's military said it had struck "Hezbollah terror infrastructure" in response to what it described as earlier action against its soldiers.

title: Saudi Arabia's dilemma as it tries to stay out of US-Iran war
summary: The kingdom faces a choice of whether to keep hitting back as a deterrent or to try to de-escalate the situation.
